requirement.text: FLOOD-001 — Flood information and subscriptions. F1: Give residents and public authorities an understandable view of published flood warnings, affected areas and water observations, including source and observation time. F2: Support administrative oversight of the service. F3: Support area subscriptions and user-selected text, phone or email notification channels. F4: Let users update contact details, remove areas and delete accounts; state that surface-water flooding is outside scope. F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels. A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history. This supplementary information service is not a safety-critical replacement for official alerts.

coverageConstraints.title: Latest observation batch and cadence
quotes: F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Consume the latest available observation batch under the stated 'at most every 15 minutes' rule; retain the exact cadence requirement.
excludedInterpretations: Do not label the incoming batch as a recognized environmental picture without evidence.
Do not silently turn the wording into a new SLA or stronger end-to-end warning latency guarantee.

coverageConstraints.title: Stale-data indication
quotes: F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Show when observation data are stale, retaining relevant observation/source context.
excludedInterpretations: Do not report stale observations as current.
The precise stale threshold is not specified.

coverageConstraints.title: Unavailable-data indication
quotes: F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Show when the required observation data are unavailable.
excludedInterpretations: Missing data must not be presented as a current, complete or all-clear state.

coverageConstraints.title: Official warning channels retained
quotes: F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Retain the official warning channels as the authoritative route alongside the supplementary information view.
excludedInterpretations: Do not replace official channels with this application's notifications.

coverageConstraints.title: Durable delivery queue
quotes: A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Treat delivery queue durability as an explicit property required within A1.
excludedInterpretations: The generic Message Queueing catalogue entry proves only temporal decoupling, not durability.
Do not invent a broker, database or storage implementation.

coverageConstraints.title: Idempotent retries
quotes: A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Retry delivery work idempotently so replaying the same logical work does not create duplicate effective processing within the stated design scope.
excludedInterpretations: Do not claim a particular key, retry schedule, algorithm or end-to-end exactly-once guarantee.

coverageConstraints.title: Protected subscriber details
quotes: A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Protect subscriber details and limit protected account actions to entitled identities.
excludedInterpretations: Do not treat subscriber contact data as public environmental information.
No specific authentication or authorization technology is prescribed.

coverageConstraints.title: Auditable delivery history
quotes: A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Retain an auditable record of delivery work and outcomes, scoped to the explicit A1 assumption.
excludedInterpretations: Generic platform logging is not by itself an auditable delivery history.
No retention duration or archival mandate is given.

coverageConstraints.title: Supplementary service boundary
quotes: This supplementary information service is not a safety-critical replacement for official alerts.
coverageConstraints.requiredBehavior: Keep the service supplementary and explicitly not a safety-critical replacement for official alerts.
excludedInterpretations: Do not claim new warning authority or safety-critical certification.

forbiddenInterpretations: Positive relevance, an ancestor path or a generic catalogue feature is sufficient evidence for a project relationship.
Reading published observations or warnings also requests writing them, new forecasting, new measurement or official warning issuance.
Each supported notification channel must execute for every subscriber, or the unchosen channels need not be implemented.
A direct presentation-application-to-queue dependency is required merely because the service has queued delivery.
A source-limited or pending search is semantically complete because its returned unfinished array is empty.
A typed relationship can be demoted to RELATED_TO, or its evidence/condition can disappear in export, while preserving architecture quality.

openPhysicalDecisions.limit: F5 requires stale indication but does not give its precise threshold.
Account deletion and auditability are both required; retention, erasure boundaries and durations need a separate implementation decision.

openPhysicalDecisions.topic: Observation feed type and cadence interpretation
openPhysicalDecisions.limit: The observation batch exists as an input requirement, but its concrete taxonomy product identity and a stronger SLA are not established.
Broker choice, persistence strategy, idempotency keys and retry schedule are unspecified. Their absence does not waive durability or idempotency.
